watch.summary: A streamer reacts with disbelief when a human referee issues a yellow card to a humanoid soccer robot.

beats.what: Creator introduces the video clip of robot sports.
Creator remarks that the situation is so weird.
The referee holds up a yellow card directly in front of a robot.
Creator points out the absurdity of giving a card to a robot.
Creator laughs in confusion as the video cuts to the robots playing.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: did I just witness this guy give a yellow card to a freaking robot
watch.why: The sight of a human referee formally enforcing rules on a robot with a yellow card provides instant visual absurdity. The creator's genuine confusion echoes what any viewer is thinking.
